summary: A 9 m kerb at a busy multi-way junction; too short and no room.
reasons: Shorter than a van plus margin

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 21 m away at the end; school and church close by.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb wraps a traffic island at a junction with painted islands; no space to pull out of lane.
drivers.traffic: Junction of several streets with turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb; no signs mapped.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the kerb from the south and east.
